description.value: MORE Café & Bakeshop is an owner-operated European bakery and café in Upper Gibsons, founded in 2012 by Andrew, Leslie, and their Master Baker Alain, and is one of only four BC bakeries making scratch croissants daily. Situated on Gibsons Way along the Sunshine Coast Highway, it sits directly on the cycling route between the community and the Langdale Ferry terminal, making it a natural stop for cyclists arriving or departing the coast. The café serves European-style pastries, muffins, sandwiches, salads, and hot beverages with dine-in seating and online ordering available.
